name: ui-libraries
description: Component-library skills split out of ui-ux: PrimeReact (v11 rewrite and licence) and a library-agnostic component-libraries skill with a per-library map of signals, theme channels and docs for every other React or Vue library (Material UI, Astryx, ReUI, Aceternity UI, Base UI, Radix, React Aria, Ark, Mantine, Chakra, Ant Design, HeroUI, PrimeVue, Vuetify…). Install alongside ui-ux, which owns shadcn, Tailwind, theming, tokens, motion and the WCAG audit.
